title: Looking for beta testers for Hereditary, my ecosystem simulation game
author: Ok-Rope-3355
selftext:
I’ve been making Hereditary, a desktop browser game where you build an ecosystem and watch it evolve. I spent several months making it without AI, using a game engine, but couldn't get it exactly where I wanted. Trying out AI, I realized I could speed past my previous obstacles and finally get the game where I wanted it to be.

Animals inherit traits, reproduce, compete for food and face diseases, predators and natural disasters. You can let nature take its course, or intervene and see what happens.

It’s ready for some outside testing, and I’d love feedback on:

Is it clear what to do and how things work?

Does it run smoothly, especially as populations grow?

What’s fun, confusing or frustrating?

Any bugs or strange animal behaviour?

Play here: [https://ai.tobiasmalm.com/](https://ai.tobiasmalm.com/)

If you report a bug, please include your browser, what happened and, if possible, a screenshot or saved world.

Thanks for giving it a try!
